messages.subject: Invited user to Shinyapps.io cannot sign in (sign in box greyed out)
parts:
I invited a user to view a private Shiny app.  In the email invitation generated by Shinyapps, he clicked on the link; on the page he could see sign up options but the main “Sign Up” was greyed out and did not respond to clicking. There were two other sign up mechanisms (Google and GitHub) but he does not use them.

I deleted the user from the invited list in my admin screen for the app and then added him again, generating a new invitation.

Same problem.

any advice?   

User using Firefox on Windows 7 Pro system.

thanks
